bukti: Orthorectified mosaics and digital surface models were created to extract canopy size variables (canopy area, average canopy height, canopy height standard deviation, and canopy volume) and visually count flower and fruit number.

bukti: This study proposes the integration of 2D detection techniques with 3D reconstruction technologies, utilizing Rays in Neural Radiance Fields(NeRF) to overcome these challenges
